Home.metaTitle: Free group scheduling poll, no account needed
Home.metaDescription: Propose a few dates, share one link and see which day works for everyone. A free group scheduling poll with no ads and no account needed.
Home.heading: Stop asking <hl>“when works?”</hl> in the group chat.
Home.lead: A free group scheduling poll. Propose some dates, share one link, and everyone ticks the days they can make. Nobody needs an account, and the best date floats to the top.
Home.minute: Takes about a minute to set up.
Home.demoHint: Try it: you're the sixth friend.
Home.demoBest: Best so far: {date} · {yes} of {total} can make it
Home.step1Body: Tap every day that could work, across as many months as you like.
Home.step2Body: Drop it in the group chat. Friends pick their name and tick the days they can make.
Home.step3Body: The date that works for the most people rises to the top. Settle on it, and it's happening.
Home.closeHeading: The group chat can go back to memes.

free.a: Yes. Creating and answering polls is free, and there are no ads.

account.q: Do people need an account to answer?
account.a: No. They open the link, pick their name (or add it) and tick the dates they can make. Creating a poll only asks for your email, so you can find your polls again later.

howTo.q: How do I find a date that works for everyone?
howTo.a: Propose every date that could work, share the poll link in your group chat, and let everyone mark the dates they can make. The dates that work for the most people are shown first, so your group can settle on one quickly.

changeAnswers.q: Can I change my answers later?
changeAnswers.a: Yes. Open the same link again and update your dates. Changes save automatically.

doodle.q: How is it different from Doodle?
doodle.a: WhenWhenWhen does one thing: find a date. No ads, no accounts and no calendar setup. <link>See the comparison</link>.

DoodleAlternative.metaTitle: Free Doodle alternative with no ads
DoodleAlternative.metaDescription: Looking for a simpler Doodle alternative? WhenWhenWhen is a free date poll with no ads and no account needed. Propose dates, share a link, done.
DoodleAlternative.heading: A simpler, free Doodle alternative
DoodleAlternative.lead: Doodle does a lot: calendars, booking pages, meeting slots. If all you need is to find a date that works for a group, WhenWhenWhen does that one thing, with no ads and no accounts.

free.title: Free, with no ads
free.body: Creating and answering polls costs nothing, and nobody sees ads.

noAccount.title: No account for your group
noAccount.body: People open the link, pick their name and tick the dates they can make.

dates.title: Built for dates, not time slots
dates.body: Propose days across several months on one calendar. Great for dinners, trips, game nights and team days.

bestDate.title: The best date at a glance
bestDate.body: The dates that work for the most people are shown first, so your group can settle quickly.

languages.title: In English and Danish
languages.body: The whole app works in both languages.

DoodleAlternative.whenDoodleHeading: When Doodle is the better choice
DoodleAlternative.whenDoodleBody: If you need to pick a time of day, connect calendars or let people book meetings with you, Doodle and similar tools are built for that. WhenWhenWhen only picks dates.
DoodleAlternative.ctaHeading: Try it for your next plan
DoodleAlternative.ctaBody: Creating a poll takes under a minute.
